source: Model examples are implementation facts, not definitions. ZXNAME0000XZ remains ZXNAME0001XZ regardless of which named models adopt it, and model families can change attention designs across sizes or generations.
zh: 模型示例是实现事实，而不是定义。无论哪个指定型号采用它，ZXNAME0000XZ 仍然是 ZXNAME0001XZ，并且型号系列可以跨尺寸或跨代改变注意力设计。
